summary: Graf Global Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing the conversion of 5,749,999 Class B ordinary shares into Class A ordinary shares by the sponsor and certain directors on June 18, 2026, on a one-for-one basis. The conversions resulted in 28,749,999 Class A shares and one Class B share outstanding. No consideration or premium is stated; the conversion was exercised irrevocably under the company's charter. The Class A shares retain the same transfer restrictions and waiver of redemption rights as the pre-conversion Class B shares. This is a routine insider conversion by a blank-check company, not a special situation. The filing references Item 3.02 (unregistered sales) and Item 8.01 (other events). The taxonomies indicate NYSE American listing of units, shares, and warrants.
